claims.claim: Added a platform-neutral immutable pairwise entity-resolution contract with exactly four outcomes, deterministic bounded confidence, auditable reasons/evidence, symmetric semantics, and preserved source-observation identities.
Resolution distinguishes exact observed variants from same-family variant differences or missing variant evidence while preserving unknown fields and marketplace-scoped identifier namespaces.
Reliable family or sellable-composition conflicts resolve as different products, while weak title, media, unscoped model-SKU, and cross-platform listing-ID similarities remain uncertain.

Added focused deterministic tests covering exact variants, variant differences, missing evidence, family conflicts, multipacks, weak media, identifier namespaces, sparse observations, symmetry, and cross-platform matching.
Documented the marketplace-listing, canonical-family, and sellable-variant identity boundary and deferred persistence, aggregation, clustering, retrieval, and RAG.
